projectorGoal: Independently derive exact selectable structural source groups from stored evidence; no UI hash reproduction, canonical importer reconstruction or native SQL proof inferred
algorithm: Bucket order is first global span occurrence of(pageId,method); inside bucket scan by(span.start,global ordinal), emit flush order. Do not physical-page-sort mixed source methods.

Derive original same-span grouping/exclusion globally first. Canonical8-label segmentation, unique field labels,2+ matched single-citation observations; employment vs education vs certification kind, dates neutral. Exclude preserved members globally.

Branch order: exact structural-trim ASCII-fold heading; out-of-scope observation OR unknown structural label (including empty) barrier; protected span; blank; prefix/block. Barrier precedes protected handling.
Blank and protected employment spans flush and retain employment section; protected nonemployment and ordinary unlabelled nonblank spans reset.

Preserve distinct canonical label segmentation, exact prefix and structural unknown-label regex policies; prefix immediate colon, separate extra-label counter permits whitespace. Do not replace with generic colon or PG lower/btrim/whitespace assumptions.

Exact labelled line needs one matching remaining observation/one citation/current span/full trimmed suffix value+range/one canonical employment label. Malformed labelled line poisons block but does not reset section.

Employer flushes/starts; Role/Dates without anchor ignored. Dates may precede Role; source member order retained. Repeated field poisons. Emit only employer+role optionaldates, no already assigned observation.
All offsets zero-based/end-exclusive Unicode codepoints. pageStart/End=span.start+local.32 is selected command cap, not truncation of all derived source groups.
